prompt: Which of these is a famous place to visit in Lebanon?
explanation: Byblos is one of the two places we'd love to visit in Lebanon. Byblos is one of the oldest cities in the world, lived in for around 7,000 years — a pretty harbour town of Crusader castles, souks and seafood restaurants.
